clips.send: A parent sends this to another parent filling the pantry - anger at being fed cattle feed labeled as food.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says almost all corn in North America now comes from Monsanto seed, bred to be fed to cattle so they put on fat fast.

His point: the same corn is doing the same job in your body.

It is not just the cob either. Corn syrup solids, high fructose corn syrup, corn starch, corn meal and corn flour are all the same ingredient wearing a different name.

His advice is simple: read the ingredient list, and watch for the word "corn" hiding in it.

How many "corn" words are on the label in your pantry right now?

#kevintrudeau #corn #gmo #labelreading #healthtruth #wbo

clips.send: A dieter sends this to a friend who just ordered a diet soda - anger at being tricked into gaining weight.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau tells of a simple test: one person drinks regular Coca-Cola, sweetened with sugar cane. Another drinks the diet version, with aspartame instead.

The diet drinker takes in far fewer calories all day. After 30 days, Kevin says the diet drinker is the one who gained weight.

His explanation: artificial sweeteners like aspartame and sucralose are, in his words, chemically addictive, acting on the same brain chemistry tied to mood.

If "diet" was supposed to mean lighter, why did the diet drinker gain?

#kevintrudeau #dietsoda #sweeteners #labelreading #healthtruth #wbo

clips.start_words: A pig eats anything in his path
clips.end_words: Your mental clarity will go up
clips.send: A friend sends this to someone who just ordered bacon - curiosity about quitting pork for more energy.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau, who grew up Italian and ate pork his whole life, decided to test going without it.

His reasoning: a pig will eat almost anything in its path, and he says that shows up in the meat itself, taking the body longer to process than other meats.

After three to four months off pork, Kevin says his energy and mental clarity noticeably improved - enough that pork chops no longer even appealed to him.

He is clear he is not a fanatic about it, just sharing what he noticed.

Would you notice the difference after three months without it?

#kevintrudeau #pork #energy #healthtruth #wholefood #wbo

clips.send: A home cook sends this to the family grocery shopper - anxiety about red tide season and shellfish risk.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's rule for seafood is simple: anything from the water without scales and fins, he avoids.

That covers shellfish, squid, octopus and catfish - what he calls nature's filters, because they absorb whatever toxin sits in the water around them.

He points to Boston's red tide seasons growing up: when the algae bloom hit, the shellfish there turned dangerous, while scaled fish like haddock and cod stayed safe to eat.

It is the same reasoning behind the old kosher seafood rule.

Did you know scales and fins were ever the test?

#kevintrudeau #shellfish #seafood #foodsafety #healthtruth #wbo

clips.send: A friend sends this to someone who always orders mussels - amusement, and a real warning inside the story.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau tells the story of his friend Mike Siegel, a ten-time world champion pool player, who kept ordering mussels on the road.

City after city, restaurant after restaurant: Mike orders mussels, and the next day he's sick. Skip them, and he's fine.

Even after noticing the pattern himself, Mike's answer was simply, "I'm still going to eat them - I love them."

Kevin's lesson: shellfish are some of the easiest foods to react to, pattern or no pattern.

Would you keep eating something that made you sick every single time?

#kevintrudeau #shellfish #foodsafety #healthtruth #wholefood #wbo

clips.send: A mom sends this to her sister buying milk - anger at finding out homogenized dairy scars arteries.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau keeps raw, unhomogenized dairy at home - milk where the cream still separates naturally, and cheese made from raw milk out of France and Switzerland.

His reasoning: homogenized dairy, he says, scars the arteries over time, disrupts hormones and adds to weight gain, and shows up as gas, bloating, diarrhea or constipation.

His swap is grass-fed, raw and unhomogenized wherever he can find it - a little less convenient, bought in small batches, but worth it to him.

Is the milk and cheese in your fridge homogenized?

#kevintrudeau #dairy #rawmilk #labelreading #healthtruth #wbo
